components.name: ArticleBody
components.summary: `.dga-prose` is the long-form reading layout for articles, blog posts and news bodies: one 680px column, Sarabun body text and Prompt headings.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: A badge is a small pill label for a content category (ข่าว, บทความ, มาตรฐาน) or the status of a project.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Use a button to start an action or go to the next step, with at most one **primary** (orange) button per view.

components.name: Callout
components.summary: A callout sets a key fact or summary box inside an article.

components.name: Footer
components.summary: The site footer is a full-width `navy` band with the logo on a white plate, contact details and link columns with orange headings.

components.name: NavBar
components.summary: The site header is a white bar with the DGA logo on the left, the main menu on the right and `shadow-sm` beneath.

components.name: NewsCard
components.summary: The news and article card from the dga.or.th home page is a 16:9 image, a category badge, a title clamped to three lines, a Thai-calendar date and a "อ่านต่อ →" link.

components.name: SectionHeader
components.summary: This is the home-page section heading from dga.or.th: an optional small navy kicker, a 32px orange title and a "ดูทั้งหมด" link on the right.

components.name: ServiceTile
components.summary: A service tile is an entry point to a major area (Policy & Regulation, Standard, มติคณะรัฐมนตรี, Open Government Data, Citizen Portal), laid out three across as on the home page.

components.name: SlideContent
components.summary: The workhorse content slide has a kicker, a title that states the takeaway, 3–5 bullets and an optional big number or chart on the right, with a footer line and the logo at bottom-right.

components.name: SlideSection
components.summary: The section divider is a full `orange` slide with a large navy section number and title, used between the parts of a long deck.

components.name: SlideTitle
components.summary: The title slide for decks is authored at 1920×1080 on a `navy` ground, with an orange kicker, a white `slide-hero` headline, a subtitle, brand colour blocks at top-right and the logo on a white plate.

components.name: StatBlock
components.summary: A stat block shows one headline number with its meaning and source, for reports, web highlights and deck summaries.

lastChange.note: First version, built from dga.or.th (colours, Prompt type, radii, shadows, logo).
